title: FBI-UAP-D010, FD-302-71, “Northeastern Orb Sighting,” 2026
doc_notes: This is an FBI FD-302 interview report regarding UAP sightings; it contains one landing encounter report from 1987.

encounters.summary: Witness observed a red light circling near power lines that hovered and then landed near a power station.
encounters.quote: saw the object hover and then land near the power station
